facts.fact: Ethio Telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel turned their cross-border fibre MoU into a binding agreement for a terrestrial corridor from Djibouti's landing stations through Ethiopia to Sudan; no signing date is given, so the published date is used.
The three telcos signed the original Horizon Fiber MoU in December 2024.

systems.owner: Djibouti Telecom, Ethio Telecom, Sudatel Group

note: Other cross-border items listed (Ghana-Togo, Kenya-Tanzania, Kenya-Uganda) do not involve DJI.
